item.title: Thalamocortical vulnerability in autism spectrum disorder: a computational model of CPEB4 mis-splicing.
item.description:
Worth reading · Neuroscience · section: Neurodevelopmental Disorders & Rare Diseases · topic is in the title · source: Primary / trusted · fits the Neurodevelopmental Disorders & Rare Diseases definition: strong · published this week

item.title: Decolonising Autistic Phenomenology: Towards a Critical-Enactive Account of Cognitive Diversity.
item.description:
Worth reading · Psychopathology · section: Neurodevelopmental Disorders & Rare Diseases · topic is in the title · source: Uncurated · fits the Neurodevelopmental Disorders & Rare Diseases definition: moderate · published this week
